name: Climax!
description: Climax! is an American anthology series that aired on CBS from 1954 to 1958. The series was hosted by William Lundigan and later co-hosted by Mary Costa. It was one of the few CBS programs of that era to be broadcast in color. Many of the episodes were performed and broadcast live.

videos.title: The Long Goodbye
videos.overview: Private Detective Philip Marlowe decides to help out a friend Lennox when his wife is found brutally murdered. Marlowe winds up in jail accused of her murder and tries to solve the case after his release.

videos.title: The Thirteenth Chair
videos.overview: When his friend is murdered, Edward Wales sets out to capture the killer. He stages a seance and invites 13 people, any one of who may have killed the dead man, but it ends in chaos when the killer strikes again during a blackout.

videos.title: Casino Royale
videos.overview: American spy James Bond must outsmart card wiz and crime boss LeChiffre while monitoring his actions. The first dramatization of a James Bond novel.

videos.title: Sorry, Wrong Number
videos.overview: A neurotic invalid whose only contact with the outside world is her phone. One night, because of a crossed wire, she hears plans for a murder which turns out to be her own. Her frantic efforts to get help and her growing terror and realisation of the truth chill you to the bone.

videos.title: The Gioconda Smile
videos.overview: The death of his crippled wife causes upheaval for the husband and his mistress. Only his family friend believes in his innocence.

videos.title: The After House
videos.overview: A steward aboard a yacht thinks his job is easy sailing until the dream voyage turns into a nightmare. The ship's officer is thrown overboard and another is hacked to death who is next.

videos.title: An Error in Chemistry
videos.overview: A carnival huckster ingratiates himself with an elderly farmer and his naïve daughter; she soon falls for her new suitor and marries him, only to wind up dead shortly afterwards, the husband quick to confess.

videos.title: Epitaph for a Spy
videos.overview: An unsuspecting Iron Curtain refugee is used as a pawn by two French traitors while he is at a resort in France.

videos.title: The White Carnation
videos.overview: A woman receives some mysterious white carnations, which seem to be an innocent gift but lead to terror.

videos.title: Nightmare in Copenhagen
videos.overview: Thru romantic eyes she knew not what he was.

videos.title: The Bigger They Come
videos.overview: Private investigators Cool and Lam become involved in this suspenseful tale of thugs, thieves and legal chicanery.

videos.title: Escape From Fear
videos.overview: An American engineer in Germany crosses over into the Soviet Zone on business and becomes entangled with the secret police.

videos.title: The Mojave Kid
videos.overview: The Mojave Kid is warned to stay away from a small town feud.

videos.title: The Leaf Out of the Book
videos.overview: The story revolves around two women, one a successful career woman, the other an ambitious girl. After giving the daughter of an old friend a job, the successful businesswoman realizes the drawbacks of her generosity.

videos.title: The Valiant Men
videos.overview: Lt. Comm. Knowles is assigned to skipper the USS Hamilton from England back to New York. While he and his crew celebrate New Year's Eve 1943, an unknown danger lurks nearby.

videos.title: The Box of Chocolates
videos.overview: A hated columnist becomes involved in murder after receiving an innocent-looking box of chocolates with a note from the manufacturer asking him to try them.

videos.title: South of the Sun
videos.overview: They were strangers to each other, even the married ones, and they all dreamed in human ways. But the least of these eight persons did something about his little dream. In so doing, he bound the strangers in an intimate circle, whether they knew it or not. He touched them all in passing and changed their lives and dreams forever, according to their own choices. In one turn of the earth something happened.

videos.title: The Great Impersonation
videos.overview: The action of this tale of intrigue and espionage takes place in the jungles of East Africa in 1914. The destinies of Germany and Great Britain are dependent upon one man whose decision is influenced by one of the two women in his life.

videos.title: The Darkest Hour
videos.overview: An ex-cop is released from San Quentin after five years and sets out on revenge against the men who framed him for manslaughter.

videos.title: The Champion
videos.overview: The famous story deals with a boxer whose rise to fame has been at the expense of friends and associates. Through flashbacks, we see how Midge Kelly rose from the Chicago slums to a world championship.

videos.title: Private Worlds
videos.overview: A woman doctor probes the twisted minds of her patients in a mental institution.

videos.title: Flight 951
videos.overview: A doctor forsakes the medical profession following a court trial where he was the defendant. Now a successful businessman travelling under an assumed name, he must decide between keeping his secret and saving the eyesight of a fellow passenger.

videos.title: The First and the Last
videos.overview: The threat of scandal, revolving around the death of a man in London, prompts an ambitious lawyer to disregard both legan and moral principles. His concern for his own career puts an innocent man's life in jeopardy.

videos.title: The Deliverance of Sister Cecilia
videos.overview: A courageous nun suffers ordeals while trying to escape from behind the Iron Curtain.

videos.title: No Stone Unturned
videos.overview: A Scottish student has the historical Stone of Scone stolen from Westminster Abbey. His purpose is to get England to recognize Scotland's independence.

videos.title: A Farewell to Arms
videos.overview: An American, in the Italian Army during World War I, who meets a nurse and falls in love with her. Together they try to find a haven from the turbulence around them.

videos.title: The Unimportant Man
videos.overview: The life of an ordinary, mild-mannered man is changed when he identifies the murderer of his employer's brother.

videos.title: The Dark Fleece
videos.overview: A gold miner returns to his righteous California hometown, circa1857. He has great wealth, but also a burdened conscious; he has killed a man.

videos.title: To Wake at Midnight
videos.overview: All the pent-up prejudices and hatreds of postwar Europe are revived when a Nazi lieutenant recovers consciousness in a British hospital after being in a coma for years.

videos.title: Wild Stallion
videos.overview: A handsome, devil-may-care fortune hunter [from South America] makes his home with a well-to-do Southern family. He is attracted at first to the daughter, until he discovers the mother is the one who holds the key to the family fortune.

videos.title: The Healer
videos.overview: A brilliant surgeon, burdened with a self-centered wife and a beautiful heiress who's in love with him, becomes tormented by doubts about his ability after losing a patient during a difficult operation.

videos.title: Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde
videos.overview: Classic Stevenson tale of a scientist whose experiments into the duality of man transform him into the misshapen, murderous Mr. Hyde.

videos.title: One Night Stand
videos.overview: In 1937, the members of a jazz ensemble come to the aid of one of their colleagues who is stricken with tuberculosis.

videos.title: Edge of Terror
videos.overview: A small town banker and his family are threatened with death if he identifies the leader of the gang that tried to rob his bank.

videos.title: Fear Strikes Out
videos.overview: True story of ballplayer battling mental illness and domineering father.

videos.title: Deal a Blow
videos.overview: A teenage boy gets into a dispute with an abusive movie theater manager Mr. Grubbs. The boy's father Tom Ditmar  accepts the manager's somewhat twisted version of the incident and doesn't give his son a chance to explain his side of the matter.

videos.title: The Adventures of Huckleberry Finn
videos.overview: Huck and Jim once again embark on their adventure-filled trek down the Mississippi .

videos.title: Public Pigeon #1
videos.overview: Cafeteria worker Rusty is cheated by stock swindlers and winds up in jail, but the crooks have to break him out in order to recover their loot, which was stashed in Rusty's safety deposit box.

videos.title: Silent Decision
videos.overview: A surgeon finds out about his wife's unfaithfulness and takes matters into his own hands.

videos.title: Night of Execution
videos.overview: A mother watches her cruel and destructive husband continually expose their young son to all kinds of violence. Finally she feels she must take steps to save her son from this sinister influence.

videos.title: Sailor on Horseback
videos.overview: As Jack London's reputation as a writer grows, his fame causes conflicts with his sister Eliza and his wife Charmain.

videos.title: Thin Air
videos.overview: An advertising executive's wife disappears during a summer vacation.

videos.title: House of Shadows
videos.overview: A woman keeps her elderly uncle locked up as a prisoner in his own home when a man decides to investigate the story himself.

videos.title: The Pink Cloud
videos.overview: An ex-con returns to New York looking for the man responsible for the crime he did time for.

videos.title: Scheme to Defraud
videos.overview: An insurance underwriter and his secretary are both disgruntled over their dull, monotonous routine. They fall in love, and then discover a way to cash in on a $70,000 insurance claim.

videos.title: A Promise to Murder
videos.overview: At his wealthy aunt's insistence, a rising young London barrister submits to having his palm read. The prophecies come true with alarming accuracy.

videos.title: Portrait in Celluloid
videos.overview: Art Shaddick, formerly a writer, now a writer's agent, sits in his gaudy, pretentious office, on the bookcase reposes an Oscar, won by Art for his last picture. That was in 1929. Since then he has gone steadily downhill, shouting all the way. When suddenly a young writer appears with a great script, it is just what Art needs, a golden opportunity to rise again to greatness.

videos.title: A Man of Taste
videos.overview: A cultured Englishman, living in Paris, becomes interested in art for purely mercenary reasons. He sponsors a young artist and goes to great lengths to keep his protege's canvases valuable.

videos.title: The Passport
videos.overview: An American correspondent, assigned to Europe shortly after World War II, is offered part of a fortune in confiscated gems in return for letting a former Nazi officer use his passport.

videos.title: The Day They Gave the Babies Away
videos.overview: While decorating a Christmas tree, narrator Joan Evans recalls the story of the Christmas of her ancestors during the 1860s in Wisconsin. A 12-year old boy becomes the head of his family when both parents die. On Christmas Eve he finds a way to provide homes for his five younger brothers and sisters.

videos.title: Bailout at 43,000 Feet
videos.overview: Three men prepare to test the ejector seat of a jet bomber. As they wait for favorable weather conditions, each reacts differently.

videos.title: The Prowler
videos.overview: A rancher's wife is bored with her monotonous life. One night when her husband is away, her mother-in-law inadvertently suggest the "perfect escape" .

videos.title: The Hanging Judge
videos.overview: One of the most despised men in the legal profession clings tenaciously to the belief that English law is infallible. Because of his fixation he even stands trial for a murder he did not commit.

videos.title: The Secret of River Lane
videos.overview: The son of a respected lawyer is involved in a case of homicide over the shooting of a schoolmate. Even though the father suspects his son's guilt, he tries to protect him. The entire town is indignant when charges are not brought against the boy immediately for lack of sufficient evidence.

videos.title: Gamble on a Thief
videos.overview: A dedicated parole officer makes a daring effort to help a two-time loser who has violated the conditions of his parole.

videos.title: The Fifth Wheel
videos.overview: Two sports-minded priests, off for a fishing holiday, become involved with thieves, a stolen car and stolen money!

videos.title: Nightmare by Day
videos.overview: The parents of a recently married young woman, whose husband claims she's taken a trip to New York, slowly become convinced she's been murdered.

videos.title: The Sound of Silence
videos.overview: A priest becomes involved in murder when the killer confesses his crime to him.

videos.title: The Louella Parsons Story
videos.overview: The Louella Parsons story, based on incidents in her autobiography ""The Gay Illiterate"", is a series of flashbacks. Teresa Wright portrays Miss Parson in the drama. As she speaks with the stars the cameras will re-create incidents in her long career. The time span is from the early twenties to 1948. We see Miss Parsons' early days as a newspaper reporter in Chicago. Here she loses her job and departs for New York. In New York she resumes her career, only to be stricken with tuberculosis. When she recovers from her illness, she meets the man who is to become her second husband, and her rise as Hollywood columnist begins. As a climax to tonight's drama, there will be a tribute from the stars of the movie industry.

videos.title: Pale Horse, Pale Rider
videos.overview: A young woman lives in fear that a recurring dream foretells real tragedy. The premonition persists when she falls in love with a young soldier about to leave for overseas duty.

videos.title: An Episode of Sparrows
videos.overview: An 11-year old girl whose home has always been the slums, steals a packet of flower seeds from a playmate. In her search for a small bit of earth in which to grow flowers, she is befriended by a youthful gang leader.

videos.title: Spin into Darkness
videos.overview: After gambling away the money her pilot husband gave her for the down payment on a plane, a woman takes a job as nurse to an alcoholic, who in a drunken stupor gives her $5,000 to recoup her losses and later reports to the police that the money was stolen.

videos.title: The Lou Gehrig Story
videos.overview: Baseball's ""Iron Horse,"" whose brilliant career was ended by a terminal illness, and who struggled valiantly against adversity.

videos.title: Sit Down with Death
videos.overview: A dinner party turns into a guest's nightmare as a murder plot is uncovered.

videos.title: The Empty Room Blues
videos.overview: When her husband disappears with their savings and their son, a woman fears for the child's life. But she can't convince her friends or the police that the man is a pathological liar and a menace.

videos.title: Flame-Out on T-6
videos.overview: Ten men are assigned to a drifting ice floe near the North Pole to test the effect of subzero weather on men supplied only with tents and meager rations. One of the men goes berserk from the strain and wrecks the group's radio so that no one can notify headquarters of their location.

videos.title: The Shadow of Evil
videos.overview: The unsuspecting girlfriend of a young man whose brother is the head of a Rome narcotics ring arrives from the United States with an investigator at her heels.

videos.title: Figures in Clay
videos.overview: After agreeing to defend an irrational old man charged with murder, an attorney finds that his partner believes he took the case for publicity reasons.

videos.title: Faceless Adversary
videos.overview: A man suspected of a young woman's murder denies even knowing her and claims he's being framed.

videos.title: To Scream at Midnight
videos.overview: A wealthy young woman breaks down and is placed in a sanitarium after being thrown over by the man she loves. Her psychiatrist becomes suspicious when the man reappears and claims he wants to marry her.

videos.title: The Circular Staircase
videos.overview: A middle aged spinster decides to go to the country for the summer with her friend. They end up becoming involved in a murder mystery.

videos.title: A Trophy for Howard Davenport
videos.overview: A Babe Ruth League team is perpetually in last place, because its compassionate manager tends to pick youngsters no other team wants. When the team has a chance to place in the finals, he turns down a boy's plea to pitch in the big game, and the boy then runs away from home.

videos.title: Phone Call for Matthew Quade
videos.overview: A retired construction firm executive seeks a respite from enforced idleness and oncoming old age. While waiting for a phone call that will confirm or deny his request for a job back at his old firm, Matthew Quade relives his past.

videos.title: Fear is the Hunter
videos.overview: A young man comes to the town of Brewster, his car in need of repairs, and is ordered to leave at once. He soon learns that the ruthless man after whom the town is named looks on any stranger as his potential murderer.

videos.title: Fury at Dawn
videos.overview: When an atomic bomb mounted on a 200-foot-tall steel tower fails to detonate, a veteran nuclear physicist and his aides have to climb the rickety tower to disarm the bomb.

videos.title: The Man Who Lost His Head
videos.overview: A young sailor collapses on the estate of a wealthy Englishman in the Orient and, upon reviving, is offered a strange bargain in exchange for his life.

videos.title: No Right to Kill
videos.overview: A starving author tests his theory about people who think they are above the law by killing a pawnbroker.

videos.title: The 78th Floor
videos.overview: On a foggy afternoon just before a plane strikes the Empire State Building, a businessman recently gone blind is in one office dictating a suicide note to his wife, while in another office a young man is trying to persuade his fiancee to help him rob the firm she works for so they can be married.

videos.title: Throw Away the Cane
videos.overview: A popular singer whose earnings are supporting his entire family returns to his home town for a visit and proceeds to make a play for the girlfriend of his twin brother, an aspiring concert pianist.

videos.title: Dark Wall
videos.overview: An extreme form of disassociative reaction to stress in which two or more separate personalities exist. The person may shift from one personality to another, which is often very different. Each personality has no memories of the other's thoughts and actions.

videos.title: Bury Me Later
videos.overview: An English vicar believes in the innocence of an artist, thought by everyone to be the murderer of a missing farmer. With the help of the murdered man's wife, he solves the mystery and unmasks the real killer.

videos.title: Burst of Violence
videos.overview: A Texas rancher whose opposition to slavery led him to fight for the Union in the Civil War returns home to find himself despised for betraying the South even by his family.

videos.title: The Garsten Case
videos.overview: Two nuclear scientists, married to each other, are working on a top-secret experiment when the woman is accidentally exposed to atomic radiation. With only a week to live, she and her husband decide to perform a series of usually fatal experiments in the name of science, with her as the subject.

videos.title: The Fog
videos.overview: A strange, poisonous fog envelops a small town. In the struggle against death in the mysterious fog, several people re-evaluate their lives and those of others close to them.

videos.title: Island in the City
videos.overview: A Puerto Rican detective in the big city tries to keep a youngster from getting into trouble, but is suspended from the force for alleged brutality to the boy.

videos.title: Journey Into Fear
videos.overview: A munitions expert goes on an arms smuggling mission to Istanbul and becomes a target for Nazi agents.

videos.title: The Midas Touch
videos.overview: The owner of a mine comes to a small South American town to investigate the cave-in, which caused his brother's death. But the townspeople refuse to co-operate.

videos.title: Night of the Heat Wave
videos.overview: After serving a six-year sentence for jewel robbery, a man is released from prison. He and his wife are threatened by characters from the underworld who believe the ex-convict knows where a missing $150,000 star-brilliant is hidden.

videos.title: Flight to Tomorrow
videos.overview: A co-owner of a small charter service plans to fake a plane crash in order to steal a casino's cash.

videos.title: Night Shriek
videos.overview: The young bride of a Jamaica plantation owner is frightened by her husband's violent outbursts of rage. She begins to believe the rumors that he was responsible for the death of his first wife, whose body was never found

videos.title: The Chinese Game
videos.overview: A newspaper columnist buys an unusual Chinese game at a curio shop. As he plays this game, he sees himself murdering his wife for another woman.

videos.title: The Secret Thread
videos.overview: On a visit to his childhood home, a man discovers a cache of stolen goods in the attic. He is injured by falling crates, and, unable to leave, finds himself at the mercy of the leader of the gang that stole the goods.

videos.title: Savage Portrait
videos.overview: After the loss of his patron and the failure of his one-man show, an artist decides that the only way he can acquire money is to steal it.

videos.title: Strange Hostage
videos.overview: The kidnapping of a retired doctor whom the criminals mistakenly believe to be wealthy is witnessed by a young boy whose story no one believes.

videos.title: Ten Minutes to Curfew
videos.overview: A paroled convict and a hoodlum are both in love with the same girl. The hoodlum tries to provoke the ex-convict into a violation of his parole.

videos.title: Carnival at Midnight
videos.overview: The elderly owner of a carnival is infatuated with the bareback rider he discovered. She rejects his love and his jealousy drives him to plot murder.

videos.title: The Gold Dress
videos.overview: Richard leaves Louella, from a prominent family, to marry Jean. Louella vows vengeance even if it's from the grave.

videos.title: Circle of Destruction
videos.overview: A ruthless convict breaks out of prison and intimidates his family into helping him stay free.

videos.title: The Trouble at Number 5
videos.overview: A middle-aged woman takes a job as a wealthy old lady's housekeeper and, in an attempt to gain the security she longs for, plots to dispose of her employer.

videos.title: The Stalker
videos.overview: A businessman who testifies against a gangster learns that the criminal is now out of jail.

videos.title: Stain of Honor
videos.overview: The son of a former governor who was assassinated is himself running for the same office when the son of the killer, who was shot while trying to escape, arrives in town under an alias. The candidate confronts the newcomer and makes it clear he plans to use the assassination to further his own career.

videos.title: The Long Count
videos.overview: After a cocky American boxer on a European tour is defeated by a French fighter, he is befriended by a beautiful cafe owner who tries to rouse him from the depression that threatens his career.

videos.title: And Don't Ever Come Back
videos.overview: A man wrongly accused of murder is released from prison only after the guilty man confesses to the crime on his deathbed. A newspaper reporter seeks to learn if the townspeople will accept the ex-convict in their midst now that it has been proved he was innocent of the crime.

videos.title: Night of a Rebel
videos.overview: A young boy is ashamed of his father's bootlegging activities. When the parents of his girlfriend refuse to let her see him, he decides to run away to the big city to become a success.

videos.title: Let It Be Me
videos.overview: Corruption in the recording industry plays out just as the music plays in.

videos.title: Strange Sanctuary
videos.overview: In the old southwest, a pair of bank robbers must ride out after killing a man. They intend on eventually getting far away, but one seeks to reunite with his daughter in a nearby convent. When he is wounded in a gunfight, they end up hiding out there, though the men from town are a mob out for their blood,sanctuary or not.

videos.title: Don't Touch Me
videos.overview: A successful woman designer returns to her small home town in an attempt to ward off an emotional breakdown. She is still tormented by the memory of a murder she witnessed as a child.

videos.title: Mad Bomber
videos.overview: Months after the arrest of New York's notorious mad bomber, new bomb threats terrorize the city. A detective begins a slow, painstaking effort to solve the case.

videos.title: Avalanche at Devil's Pass
videos.overview: Among the passengers on a train trapped by an avalanche are a possessive woman, the irresponsible playboy she's been following, a man hunting for a drug addict, and a conductor awaiting news of the birth of his first child.

videos.title: Strange Deaths at Burnleigh
videos.overview: At the turn of the century, Scotland Yard receives letters accusing a village doctor of killing some of his patients. The detective sent to investigate is opposed by the townspeople and the doctor's attractive young niece.

videos.title: Bait for the Tiger
videos.overview: Two swindlers in Italy hire a hungry novelist to find a woman who will pose as a missing countess entitled to an inheritance. Their plans go haywire when one conspirator is driven to murder.

videos.title: The Hand of Evil
videos.overview: Poison pen letters threaten the career of a brilliant young college instructor whose pregnant wife has just inherited half a million dollars.

videos.title: The Disappearance of Amanda Hale
videos.overview: An actress is plagued with dread before opening night when her leading man suddenly falls ill, a man follows her on her way to the theater, and she narrowly escapes injury from a falling sandbag.

videos.title: Mr. Runyon of Broadway
videos.overview: New York sportswriter Damon Runyon becomes interested in a young boxer and backs him in an upcoming bout, which gamblers try to make him throw by involving his wife in a rigged crap game.

videos.title: The Man Who Stole the Bible
videos.overview: At carnival time in Havana an American salesman rescues an attractive woman from revelers, spends some time with her, and finds his hotel room ransacked when he returns.

videos.title: A Taste for Crime
videos.overview: To prove his connection between body chemistry and the criminal mind, a wealthy society doctor secretly joins forces with a hunted fugitive.

videos.title: The Trial of Captain Wirtz
videos.overview: During the Civil War, thousands of captured Union soldiers were confined in the Andersonville stockade in Georgia. Conditions there were so bad that over 12,000 prisoners died and the infamous reputation of the Andersonville stockade spread. When the war ended, steps were taken to bring to justice those responsible. The trial of Captain Henry Wirz, commandant of the Andersonville prison and the charge--conspiracy to commit atrocities and murder among the prisoners. The Union prosecutor is determined to prove that Wirz himself shot down one of the prisoners.

videos.title: False Witness
videos.overview: A man dies in an unfortunate accident at an remote hunting lodge. A passing bum who saw the accident threatens to testify that the death was no accident-- unless the widow and her mother give him cash and a home.

videos.title: Payment for Judas
videos.overview: When one of the ranchers resisting an unscrupulous railroad agent's efforts to buy them out breaks ranks and decides to sell, the other ranchers turn against him, his wife scorns him and her brother is murdered.

videos.title: Walk a Tightrope
videos.overview: A man arrested for a murder that was committed for no apparent reason claims he was hired by the victim's wife.

videos.title: The High Jungle
videos.overview: A steel tycoon finds that his company is threatened by a younger man who is trying to gain control through the proxy votes of the shareholders. The older man approaches his late partner's widow in an effort to gain her support, but learns that she has already promised to help the young man.

videos.title: The Giant Killer
videos.overview: A short man who's sensitive about his height picks a fight on the job over the issue. Then his wife gives him a pair of shoes designed to make him look taller.

videos.title: Trail of Terror
videos.overview: Murdered doctor had been researching a rare disease.

videos.title: Murder is a Witch
videos.overview: After meeting a woman who tells him she desperately needs money for an operation for her mother, a young man agrees to go along with a friend planning a robbery.

videos.title: The Stranger Within
videos.overview: A young man is visiting the sister of a friend who was killed in South America when the woman claims she's being poisoned by her doctor stepfather and begs the young man to help her.

videos.title: Deadly Climate
videos.overview: A woman vacationing off the New England coast reports that she witnessed a murder while walking in the woods. But no one in the small island town believes her except a reporter who finds a shoe at the scene of the alleged crime.

videos.title: Trial by Fire
videos.overview: A forest fire spreads with fury, threatens a town with destruction, and brands a boy a murderer.

videos.title: The Secret of the Red Room
videos.overview: The technical notes say that this television drama was in black and white. But I remember its being broadcast in color, one of the very few broadcasts in color at that time. I remember because my father was trying out, on loan, a new color television set, and we saw this broadcast as a test of the color quality of the broadcast and of the set. The quality was good for this broadcast, as I recall, but not for all broadcasts.

videos.title: Necessary Evil
videos.overview: When a man with the reputation of a fast gun turns up in a small New Mexico community, the townspeople, including the man's son, want no part of him. Then two brothers who have vowed revenge on the gunfighter ride into town.

videos.title: Along Came a Spider
videos.overview: As she's leaving to meet her daughter at the airport, a psychoanalyst receives a phone call from one of her patients, who tells her he's just killed a man. When the two women return home the patient, who is waiting for them, pulls a gun, forces the daughter into a room, and locks the door.

videos.title: Jacob and the Angels
videos.overview: A criminal lawyer makes a desperate gamble to defend a boy charged with murder. Risking his career, his love, even his health, he faces an even greater terror when he finds his own guilty conscience is on trial.

videos.title: Mask for the Devil
videos.overview: Tom Gardener invites the invalid widow of a man he accidentally killed to live with himself and his wife, unaware that her facade of sweetness and gentleness conceals a scheme to destroy his marriage.

videos.title: The Largest City in Captivity
videos.overview: An American newspaperman in West Berlin and an East German freedom fighter in the anti-Soviet underground are in love with the same woman, in whose apartment the freedom fighter takes refuge after being wounded.

videos.title: Tunnel of Fear
videos.overview: Drama about the men who struggle to move rivers and dig tunnels.

videos.title: Keep Me in Mind
videos.overview: Publicity hungry, Las Vegas lounge singer, Mike Owens stages a hoax publicity stunt making the local police and his entourage furious with him, especially his press agent. And like the little boy who cried wolf, he discovers when he actually can identify a cop-killer, the cops and the newspapers and his press agent don't believe him. But the killer knows he isn't lying and determines to kill him next.

videos.title: Two Tests on Tuesday
videos.overview: A college professor tries to help an ex-GI with a history of mental illness whose anxiety over low grades caused him to cheat on his final exam.

videos.title: A Matter of Life and Death
videos.overview: A man wakes up with a hangover one morning believing he is responsible for a murder. All he can remember is standing over a body holding a broken bottle in his hand. The girl in love with him is convinced he is innocent and helps him try to prove

videos.title: Murder Has a Deadline
videos.overview: A ruthless gossip columnist who's been receiving threatening letters asks for police protection and then, in a panic attack, barricades himself in his apartment.

videos.title: The Devil's Brood
videos.overview: Two fugitives, hoping for a life of ease and respectability, leave for Australia to buy a sheep ranch, not knowing they're being followed by a blackmailer.

videos.title: Hurricane Diane
videos.overview: Among the people seeking shelter from a flood at a rundown Southern hotel are a man accused of murder, the deputy sheriff to whom he's handcuffed, a compassionate young social worker, a preacher, and the hotel owner's disturbed wife who claims she's a countess.

videos.title: To Walk the Night
videos.overview: On a snowy Christmas eve, police detective Ed Brooks hopes to be able to get away early. But a call comes in that a prowler, who has murdered several women, has struck again.

videos.title: Shadow of a Memory
videos.overview: A woman returns to the cottage owned by her late husband and tries to settle in, but a body is discovered in the living room and she is accused of murder.

videos.title: Scream in Silence
videos.overview: Medical student tries to help depressed neighbor.

videos.title: Thieves of Tokyo
videos.overview: While on the trail of a black-market ring in Tokyo, an undercover man runs across a murder. During the investigation he begins to date a pretty Japanese dancer, which upsets his American girlfriend.

videos.title: Sound of the Moon
videos.overview: Facing a personal crisis on a coast-to-coast flight, an airline hostess appeals for help to a doctor on the plane, but he claims he's too busy to see her.

videos.title: Burst of Fire
videos.overview: A singer orders a copy made of an antique cross for an old friend of hers, a priest. While she is in the jewelry store to pick up the cross, the store is held up by a masked gunman who steals the cross and makes his escape. The thief resembles the priest's brother. Then the third brother, a policeman, is assigned to investigate the case.

videos.title: Four Hours in White
videos.overview: Trapped in a crossfire of human emotions, a hospital chief surgeon fights his own conscience to decide the fate of two men. He must weigh the possible sacrifice of one life for another. Drawing on years of experience, he defies the pressures of time and personal fear to face one crucial moment of judgment.

videos.title: The Secret Love of Johnny Spain
videos.overview: Four days before his movie is to be released, singing idol Johnny Spain is killed in an airplane crash. His press agent decides he must dig up some publicity to make the up-coming movie pay-off. He pressures Julie, a young starlet, to pose as Spain's secret love.

videos.title: Albert Anastasia, His Life and Death
videos.overview: The story of Murder Inc. and the 1957 barber shop rub-out of mob czar Albert Anastasia. Anastasia had an appeal that belied his reputation for brutality and impetuosity. He had a sense of confidence and presence, and because he was so sure of himself he was at ease with other people.

videos.title: The Thief With the Big Blue Eyes
videos.overview: In Rome, an American actor and his wife come upon an Italian street urchin who appoints himself their guardian angel and after awhile begins trying to cajole them into adopting him permanently.

videos.title: So Deadly My Love
videos.overview: While on a date with her boyfriend a woman runs into her erratic estranged husband. Later that night two ruffians beat up the boyfriend and kidnap the woman.

videos.title: The Great World and Timothy Colt
videos.overview: A large Manhattan law firm hires the tireless dedicated Timothy Colt, the young lawyer. As he rises in the firm the opportunity to see the conflict between ethics and ambition are upon him. His disillusionment  and the constant dishonesty shakes him to his foundations of belief against the bitter cynical conquest of his new great world.

videos.title: On the Take
videos.overview: In trying to clean up the local bookmakers, the Washington, D.C. Police department becomes convinced that members of the force are accepting payoff money. Lt. Todd Thoman is assigned the task of discovering the crooked cops.

videos.title: The Volcano Seat
videos.overview:
This true story involving the crew of an in-air refueling operation for Air Force bombers who take a training team on a dangerous mission.

RAF Flight Lieutenant MacKenzie Barton is assigned to an American Air Force base as a result of an exchange of pilots between the RAF and the U.S. Air Force. Barton receives orders to pilot an Air Force tanker--a plane which is capable of refueling jet bombers in mid-air. But in trying to gain the confidence of the American crew members, Barton encounters only resentment. The story is based on an actual experience.

videos.title: Shooting for the Moon
videos.overview: Engineer Frank Colby and his staff have developed a nose cone capable of launching into outer space.

videos.title: The Deadly Tattoo
videos.overview: A detective is assigned to investigate a series of murders in which the killer left a heart-shaped tattoo on each of his victims.

videos.title: The Big Success
videos.overview: Leo Carson a businessman who worked his way up from machinist's helper to owner of a million-dollar business. He realizes too late that the important things in life, his family have chosen destructive lifestyles and his own mistakes have caused harm to everyone else.

videos.title: The Disappearance of Daphne
videos.overview: A young heiress marries a dancer after a whirlwind courtship, but soon comes to suspect he's responsible for the mysterious disappearance of his former dancing partner.

videos.title: Time of the Hanging
videos.overview: In Texas, during the 1880's, cattlemen resent the intrusion of homesteaders on their grazing lands. When cattleman Mannon Tate's brother is sentenced to hang for the murder of a homesteader, Tate makes a desperate attempt to prevent the execution. Believing the sheriff is allied with the farmers, Tate takes him and his wife hostage.

videos.title: The Push-Button Giant
videos.overview: A song plugger making his daily rounds meets an attractive young singer in a recording executive's waiting room and, by passing himself off as her manager, begins climbing to the top of the music world.

videos.title: Spider Web
videos.overview: JosÃ© Aragon, wealthy Texas cattleman, is on a cattle-buying expedition on the Mexican border. After a gueling day looking over the stock, Aragon returns to his hotel, tired and dirty. A beautiful young woman sees Aragon enter the hotel, and, because of his unkempt appearance, believes he is one of the local peasants. She approaches him and asks him to do her a favor. Amused when she offers him five dollars for the errand, Aragon consents to cross the border and pick up a package for her.

videos.title: House of Doubt
videos.overview: When she loses her job, Gwen Dacres seeks economical lodgings in a boarding house run by a mysterious old woman, Mrs. Garr. Strange noises and incidents disturb Gwen's peace of mind. Gwen is attacked and Mrs. Garr disappears and is later found dead. Gwen starts to investigate and uncovers a twenty year old mystery.

videos.title: Cabin B-13
videos.overview: Shortly after Ann and Robert Brewster board a luxury liner for their honeymoon cruise, Robert disappears with the fortune he received as a wedding present from Ann. Ann reports her husband's disappearance to the captain. To her astonishment he informs her that there is no record of either herself or her husband as passengers, and that the cabin number she has given is non-existent.

awards: Nominated for 13 Primetime Emmys. 16 nominations total
